review.official:
A Rank 4 Knight of
Kazimierz
, staying at
Rhodes Island
for
undisclosed reasons
.
Proficient in covert ops and assassinations, Gravel volunteered to be the
Doctor
's personal bodyguard.

files.description:
Imaging tests on this Operator show clear outlines of internal organs, with no abnormal dark spots or shadows. No unusual traces of Originium particles present in the circulatory system, no signs of infection, confirming this operator as uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Gravel showed no signs of infection. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L 
Operator Gravel rarely comes into contact with Originium.

A girl no one would ever believe is a knight, were she not to divulge that fact. 
Some of the things she says about the Doctor have raised questions about her mental state... Fortunately, no other issues have been reported. 
Blushes easily when excited or emotional.

Gravel is a level-4 knight, barely mid-rank in the hierarchy. 
But the title 'Knight of Kazimierz' is itself a status symbol. It is hard to imagine another knight with such status, other than Miss Nearl, who would stay with a little-known outfit like Rhodes Island. 
Of course, Gravel is a special case, since her reasons for being here are obvious to everyone.

With the passage of time, knighthood has evolved from a title of nobility to a profession. No longer do they maintain a stuffy, goody-two-shoes image. 
Knights versed in covert ops such as Gravel are now fairly common. 
But to rise to knighthood from such a humble background like Gravel's is still a rarity. 
Indeed, she was sold to Kazimierz as 'chattel,'with a barcode on her shoulder an indelible reminder of her origins. 
From those modest beginnings, she worked her way up the ladder to eventually become a level-4 knight, and just as she refuses to hide her barcode covered, has never hidden her past from her curious comrades. 
While we don't speak of people as 'chattel' here at Rhodes Island, and knights don't have any special status over anyone else, her honesty and openness is still very much appreciated.

Most Operators at Rhodes Island answer to their codenames as their new names. They leave their pasts behind, and some use those codenames as the first step intheirnew lives at Rhodes Island. Naturally, to some it is merely a convenience, rather than anything so meaningful. 
To Gravel, however, divulging her real name to someone she trusts carries a very special meaning--that she is sharing her 'chattel' identity and her knight identity with that person. 
This is a privilege even the Kazimierz family that endowed her with knighthood has not yet enjoyed.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Aaaahhh! You want me to stay by your side? I can barely keep my heart in my chest!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Fascinating...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Don't mind me, just continue with your work.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hmm? What am I looking at? Why, you, of course!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: If that's what you ask, Doctor, I will do what it takes to become stronger.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Heheh... You don't need to worry about any ambushes or assassination attempts. Because I'll aaalways be here with you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Are you finally... a little bit interested in me now? Well, I've always been a big bit interested in you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Thanks for taking such good care of me these days. By my knighthood of Kazimierz, I hereby pledge to repay your kindness with my life—huh? You're not used to me talking this way? But I'm an honest-to-goodness knight. Surely I can improvise a speech or two.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ever since I was taken away to Kazimierz, it's rare for someone to be so kind to me. So, if you don't mind, Doctor... I, Gravel—no, I Senomy, on my honor as a knight, shall serve you always at your side.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: When I'm here with you, don't you feel your heart racing?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Mmmwah. Hm? What's wrong? Your face is beet red. That's just how I say hello. Don't think too much about it. Anyway, I'm Gravel, a knight of Kazimierz. It's a pleasure. Heheh.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are you the one who comes up with all the Rhodes Island's battle tactics, Doctor? Oh~ that's even more intriguing.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You think I'm doing well, Doctor? Yaay!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This means you need me, doesn't it? Heheh.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: You want to go together? Hehe...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Oh~ You chose me!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'll come with you~

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hehehe...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Any orders for me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This is the place~

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Surely a good spot.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I am your shadow.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hehehe...

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You really think you'll get away?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Gather up, my rats!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Of course the Doctor's tactics are flawless~

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: My blade hasn't even been stained red yet... hehe...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Run all you like, Let's see how far you can get.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Sorry... did I... mess up again...?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hmm, looks like there's a lot of good hiding places here in this room~

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hehehe...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Yes. I'm right here, always and forever.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Give me your hand—mmmwah—hm? What are you so surprised for? Kissing the hands of those we've sworn to protect is how us knights of Kazimierz celebrate the New Year, you know. You've never heard of it? Sounds like you need to pay a little more attention.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How are you today, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: How daring of you to tear open a gift package with no sender, Doctor. With that little caution, trouble's bound to come knocking sooner or later~ Actually, rather than being on my toes all day as your bodyguard, how about I just open these up for you, hm?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, does it ever keep you up at night... that you might never find any trace of your past again? Whenever I step out onto Rhodes Island's deck, I wonder, would walking away from here bring me any closer to my forgotten memories?... Say, Doctor, don't you know you're supposed to console me, when I bring down the mood like this?
